Regulators Propose Stricter Capital Rules for Mid-Sized Banks
By Sarah Jenkins, Financial Times Correspondent

WASHINGTON — Federal banking regulators unveiled a sweeping proposal on Tuesday that would require regional banks with assets between $100 billion and $250 billion to include unrealized losses on available-for-sale (AFS) securities when calculating their regulatory capital ratios.

Previously, only the nation's largest global systemically important banks (G-SIBs) were subject to this accounting treatment. Under the new rule, mid-sized lenders would have a three-year phase-in period to build additional capital buffers.

Industry groups immediately pushed back, warning that the mandate could force regional banks to curtail small-business lending and pass higher borrowing costs onto corporate clients. However, consumer advocates and independent banking analysts praised the measure, noting that unrealized bond losses were a primary catalyst behind several high-profile regional bank failures two years ago. Public comments on the proposal will remain open for 60 days.

• 解析：男士來電查詢上週開立的國際信用狀（international letter of credit）結算進度，(C)「確認一項跨境貿易融資工具的付款進度」為同義改寫（international letter of credit → cross-border trade finance instrument；settlement status → payout progress）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 credit limit，但限額已核准，非申請調高；(A) 出現原文 commercial invoice、packing list，但男士已知已寄出；(B) 出現原文 freight forwarder、treasury team，但非尋求推薦。

questions.q: What documentation does the woman say is required?
options: A revised application for reference LC-8842
A credit-limit approval letter from the trade finance team
Carrier-certified proof that the merchandise was loaded aboard a ship
A signed packing list from Pacific Rim Imports

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士表示貿易融資團隊需要貨運承攬商蓋章的裝船表格（stamped shipping form from the freight carrier），確認貨物已裝上船隻，(C)「由承運商認證、證明貨物已裝船的文件」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 application、LC-8842，但申請書已存在；(D) 出現原文 packing list，但該文件已收到；(B) 出現原文 credit limit、trade finance team，為概念錯置。

questions.q: What does the woman mean when she says, "Our compliance queue is backed up until Friday"?
options: The freight forwarder missed the Friday afternoon cutoff.
Additional compliance fees will apply after Friday.
The man's request cannot be finalized right away.
The man uploaded his documents to the wrong portal.

explain.text:
• 考點：意圖題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士說「我們的法遵審核佇列已積壓到週五」，意即無法當天立刻處理放款，對應 (C)「她無法立即完成男士的請求」。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 upload，過度推論系統錯誤；(A) 出現原文 freight forwarder、Friday afternoon，但貨運商已寄出文件；(B) 過度推論週五會加收費用。

questions.q: What are the speakers discussing?
options: A jump in commercial loan defaults during the second quarter
A decline in promotional CD deposits compared to Q1
A plan to launch a digital-only high-yield savings product
A narrowing of the bank's lending-versus-deposit profit spread

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題（同義替換）。
• 解析：兩人討論第二季淨利差（net interest margin）較第一季下滑 22 個基點，(D)「銀行放款與存款利差獲利空間的縮窄」為精準同義改寫（net interest margin dropped → narrowing of lending-versus-deposit profit spread）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 loan defaults、Q2，但男士明確否定是違約造成；(C) 出現原文 digital-only、high-yield savings，那是競爭對手的產品；(B) 出現原文 promotional CD、Q1，敘述相反。

questions.q: According to the man, what caused the recent shift?
options: Rival internet banks offering more attractive yields to savers
A sudden drop in the bank's credit quality across Q2 loans
Customers withdrawing funds from top five online banks
Rapidly falling interest rates on the bank's loan portfolio

explain.text:
• 考點：原因題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士指出主因是網路競爭對手調高存款利率至 4.8%，迫使自家銀行跟進調高定存利率，(A)「競爭網路銀行提供存戶更具吸引力的利率」為同義改寫（online competitors → rival internet banks；higher deposit rates → more attractive yields）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 credit quality、Q2，與對話內容相反；(D) 出現原文 loan yields，對話說的是資金成本上升快於放款利率重定價；(C) 誤解資金是流向對手而非從對手流出。

questions.q: What will the woman prepare for tomorrow's briefing?
options: A report on afternoon deposit outflows
A side-by-side rate chart benchmarking against competing institutions
A proposal to lower promotional CD rates to 4.8 percent
A Q2 earnings variance summary for the top five online banks

explain.text:
• 考點：任務細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士請女士為明天簡報製作「競爭對手定價比較表」（competitor pricing comparison table），對比前五大網銀與自家存款利率，(B)「與競爭機構進行基準對比的並列利率圖表」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 Q2 earnings variance、top five online banks，將不同概念混在一起；(C) 出現原文 promotional CD rates、4.8 percent，但 4.8% 是網銀活存利率；(A) 出現原文 afternoon、deposit outflows，非簡報內容。

questions.q: What is the relationship among the speakers?
options: They are treasury desk specialists processing SWIFT and ACH transfers.
They are facilities maintenance supervisors reviewing Q2 budgets.
They are internal investigators examining suspected payment irregularities.
They are external vendors disputing duplicate billing records.

explain.text:
• 考點：人物關係題（三人對話＋同義替換）。
• 解析：自動防詐欺引擎觸發警報，三人集結調查應付帳款模組的異常請款模式，顯示他們是 (C)「調查疑似付款異常的內部稽核／調查人員」（原文 forensic accountants investigating an internal fraud alert 的同義改寫）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 facilities maintenance、Q2，但那是涉案成本中心；(A) 出現原文 treasury desk、SWIFT、ACH，但 M2 只是向資金部調閱收據；(D) 出現原文 vendor、duplicate，但他們不是外部廠商。

questions.q: What anomaly did the woman discover in the vendor ledger?
options: Fourteen payments exceeding the $10,000 secondary review threshold
Invoices missing routing and account numbers for facilities maintenance
Repeated charges submitted through minor variations in supplier codes
Automated fraud alerts disabled in the Accounts Payable module

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士在供應商分類帳發現 14 筆重複發票，皆以微調過的供應商編號（如加連字號或補零）請款，對應 (C)「透過微幅變動的供應商代碼重複請款」。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 14、$10,000 secondary review threshold，但對話說「低於」一萬美元而非超過；(D) 出現原文 automated fraud alerts、Accounts Payable module，並非系統被關閉；(B) 出現原文 routing and account numbers、facilities maintenance，概念錯置。

questions.q: What does the third speaker instruct the team to do first?
options: Obtain source bank transfer records to verify payment destinations
Escalate the $96,000 discrepancy to the external auditors
Lock the suspect user profiles in the Accounts Payable module
Interview the facilities maintenance supervisor on short notice

explain.text:
• 考點：順序細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：M1 指示在約談任何人或鎖定帳號前，先調出原始銀行轉帳確認單（original bank transfer confirmations）追蹤帳號，(A)「取得原始銀行轉帳紀錄以核實款項去向」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 lock any user profiles、Accounts Payable module，但 M1 明言「先不要」鎖定；(D) 出現原文 interview、facilities maintenance，同樣是被延後的動作；(B) 出現原文 $96,000，未提呈報外部稽核。

questions.q: What does the man want to know about the IPO roadshow?
options: Why Tuesday's luncheon was limited to 18 mutual funds
When the Boston leg of the roadshow will officially begin
Whether NovaMed Systems agreed to the $22 to $25 price range
Whether major buyers have finalized their participation for a specific city stop

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士一開場就問波士頓站的機構投資人是否都已確認出席（confirmed their attendance for the Boston leg），(D)「大型買方是否已確定參與特定城市場次」為同義改寫（institutional investors → major buyers；Boston leg → specific city stop）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 Tuesday's luncheon、18 mutual funds，對話未問原因；(B) 出現原文 Boston leg，男士已知在 48 小時內出發；(C) 出現原文 NovaMed Systems、$22 to $25，非男士提問內容。

questions.q: What does the woman say about the sovereign wealth fund?
options: It asked to lower the share price below the $22 range.
Its chief investment officer will host Tuesday's Boston luncheon.
It intends to serve as a cornerstone investor with a substantial order.
It is still deciding whether to participate in the bookbuilding process.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士表示主權財富基金計畫以 7,500 萬美元的認購承諾作為此次發行的基石（anchor the offering with a $75 million commitment），(C)「打算以大額認購擔任基石投資人」為精準同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 chief investment officer、Tuesday's Boston luncheon，人物與事件錯置；(A) 出現原文 $22，但條件是在 22–25 美元區間內而非壓低；(D) 出現原文 bookbuilding process，對方已經明確表達認購意向。

questions.q: What will the man do before 3:00 P.M.?
options: Contact the two pension boards to verify their $75 million commitment
Send the offering price range to the sovereign wealth fund
Confirm flight reservations for the Boston roadshow team
Revise the pitch materials with fresh peer-company valuation figures

explain.text:
• 考點：行動細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士表示會在下午三點前用最新同業估值倍數更新投資人簡報（update the investor presentation slide deck with the latest comparable-company multiples），(D)「以最新同業估值數據修訂簡報資料」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 flight、Boston，但未提要訂機票；(A) 出現原文 two pension boards、$75 million，金額錯置（7,500 萬是主權基金）；(B) 出現原文 sovereign wealth fund，動作無中生有。

questions.q: What issue does the woman report regarding the client's estate trust?
options: The custodian's ledger miscalculated a $42,000 capital gain.
An automated reinvestment feature bought back shares shortly after a loss sale.
The trust missed the November 4 deadline for year-end tax harvesting.
Vanguard Industrial Corp. suspended its dividend-reinvestment program.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士發現信託在 11 月 4 日認賠賣出股票後，股利自動再投資計畫（DRIP）於 11 月 18 日自動買回 120 股同支股票，(B)「自動再投資機制在認賠賣出後不久又買回股份」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 custodian's ledger、$42,000，4.2 萬是虧損而非獲利；(C) 出現原文 November 4、year-end tax harvesting，未提錯過截止日；(D) 出現原文 Vanguard Industrial Corp.、dividend-reinvestment program，並未暫停該計畫。

questions.q: Why does the man say, "That's a classic wash-sale trap"?
options: To explain why the IRS requires trusts to hold stocks for 30 days
To criticize the custodian for buying 5,000 shares on November 18
To note that a rapid repurchase invalidates the claimed tax deduction
To suggest waiting until December to sell the remaining 120 shares

explain.text:
• 考點：意圖題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士提到「30 天內買回同一檔股票，國稅局會否准該部分稅務虧損抵減」，(C)「指出短期內買回會使申報的稅務抵減失效」為精準同義改寫（within 30 days → rapid repurchase；disallows tax loss → invalidates claimed tax deduction）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 5,000 shares、November 18，數量與日期錯置（18 號買的是 120 股）；(A) 出現原文 IRS、30 days，曲解稅法規定；(D) 出現原文 December、120 shares，建議錯置。

questions.q: What does the woman suggest doing to resolve the situation?
options: Waiting until January to turn off the automatic reinvestment setting
Reinvesting future dividends into a different individual industrial stock
Asking the IRS for a 30-day exemption on the November 18 trade
Exiting the position and reallocating into a broader industry fund

explain.text:
• 考點：建議題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士建議賣掉整個部位並以廣泛的工業類股 ETF 實質替代（sell the entire position... replace with a broad industrial sector ETF），(D)「出清該持股並轉進更廣泛的產業型基金」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 IRS、30-day、November 18，對話未提申請豁免；(B) 出現原文 industrial stock，應改為 ETF 而非個股；(A) 過度推論等到一月才關閉再投資。

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽線索＋看表格）。
• 解析：對話中女士刻意不唸出公司名稱，而是說「我最擔心倍數最低（lowest multiple）的那家，因為它的負債權益比超過 2.5（over 2.5）」。對照圖表，EV/EBITDA 倍數最低（7.9x）且負債權益比達 2.60（超過 2.5）的標的為 (A) Crestline Packaging。
• 誘答分析：(C) Apex Logistics（1.85）與 (D) Delta Biopharma（$18M synergy）皆在對話中被男士提及作為干擾；(B) Boreal Tech 為倍數最高（14.8x）的對比項。

questions.q: Why does the woman express concern about that company?
options: Its 14.8x valuation multiple is too expensive for the steering committee.
Its management refused to agree to a cash-free transaction.
Its heavy borrowing burden could squeeze liquidity after the merger.
Its projected 3-year synergies are lower than Boreal Tech's.

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表延伸細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士補充指出承受過高槓桿若遇高利率將嚴重壓縮併購後現金流（strain our post-merger cash flow），(C)「沉重的舉債負擔可能在合併後擠壓流動資金」為同義改寫（leverage → borrowing burden；strain cash flow → squeeze liquidity）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 14.8x、steering committee，但 14.8x 是 Boreal Tech 的倍數；(D) 出現原文 projected 3-year synergies、Boreal Tech，非擔心主因；(B) 出現原文 cash-free，曲解談判條件。

questions.q: What does the man propose to address the concern?
options: Dropping the target from the M&A steering committee's shortlist
Using projected synergies to refinance the seller's debt
Offering a higher multiple if interest rates decline
Mandating that existing liabilities be paid off by the current owner at closing

explain.text:
• 考點：解決方案題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士提議在購買協議中要求賣方在交割前用現金價款清償現有債務（require the seller to retire existing debt prior to closing），(D)「規定原持有者在交割時須將現有負債結清」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 multiple、interest rates，未提提高倍數；(A) 出現原文 M&A steering committee、shortlist，過度推論剔除名單；(B) 出現原文 synergies，未提用綜效再融資。

questions.q: Why is the man visiting the bank's commercial lending office?
options: To ask Ms. Brooks to waive a 30 percent jump in supplier fees
To repay an existing $2.5 million spring inventory loan
To negotiate a lower interest rate on his current credit line
To seek short-term financing to support a seasonal stock buildup

explain.text:
• 考點：目的題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士來訪是為了申請 250 萬美元營運資金貸款額度，以支應春季季節性庫存擴張（finance your seasonal inventory expansion），(D)「尋求短期融資以支應季節性備貨需求」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 $2.5 million、spring，但非來償還舊債；(A) 出現原文 Ms. Brooks、30 percent、supplier，曲解 30% 的含義（是訂單成長而非費用）；(C) 出現原文 credit line，非協商降息。

questions.q: What does the woman say about the company's current ratio?
options: It sits just under the institution's required liquidity benchmark.
It dropped by 30 percent due to spring wholesale orders.
It is too low to qualify for any policy exception from the credit committee.
It improved from 1.12x to 1.25x over the past quarter.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士指出貴公司流動比率為 1.12x，略低於銀行最低核貸門檻 1.25x（falls slightly below our bank's minimum loan approval threshold），(A)「略低於本機構要求的流動性基準」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 30 percent、spring wholesale orders，兩者無關；(C) 出現原文 policy exception、credit committee，對話明確說「可能」有機會申請例外；(D) 出現原文 1.12x、1.25x，混淆為數值改善。

questions.q: What does the woman suggest the man provide?
options: Proof that spring wholesale orders have already been paid
A detailed breakdown showing how recently customer invoices were billed
A revised profitability forecast for the next 30 days
A written guarantee from the company's spring suppliers

explain.text:
• 考點：建議細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士建議男士提供更新版「應收帳款帳齡表」（updated aging schedule of accounts receivable），證明多數帳款逾期未超過 30 天，(B)「顯示客戶發票開立時間長短的詳細明細」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 spring wholesale orders，應收帳款尚未收現；(C) 出現原文 profitability、30 days，概念混用；(D) 出現原文 spring、suppliers，對象錯置（是客戶應收帳款而非供應商）。

questions.q: According to the man, what specific flaw was uncovered in that area?
options: Departed staff members still possessed high-level system entry rights.
Dormant user accounts had not been reviewed in the past six years.
Eighteen current finance employees shared a single administrative password.
Deloitte auditors were unable to log in to the accounting module.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士說明稽核員發現過去六個月離職的 18 名「前員工」仍保有會計模組的管理員登入憑證（former employees... still retained administrative login credentials），(A)「已離職員工仍擁有高權限系統登入權」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 Deloitte、accounting module，未提稽核員無法登入；(C) 出現原文 18、finance，將離職員工誤植為現職人員共用密碼；(B) 出現原文 six，將「六個月」誤植為「六年」。

questions.q: What does the woman say R. Patel has already started doing?
options: Deactivating unused accounts and mandating multi-step login verification
Training former employees on updated finance department security rules
Preparing a May 15 progress report for the Deloitte audit team
Auditing all four open findings ahead of the June deadlines

explain.text:
• 考點：行動細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士表示 R. Patel 已經開始撤銷所有休眠帳號權限，並強制實施雙重驗證（revoking all dormant user privileges and enforcing mandatory two-factor authentication），(A)「停用閒置帳號並強制啟用多步驟登入驗證」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 May 15、Deloitte，未提撰寫進度報告；(B) 出現原文 former employees、finance department，動作荒謬；(D) 出現原文 four open findings、June，過早推論。

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽線索＋看表格）。
• 解析：對話未直接唸出級別名稱，而是給出雙重條件：「不需要任何鎖定期（zero lock-up）」且「董事會禁止支付任何績效獎金（zero performance fee）」。對照圖表，同時滿足 Performance Fee 為 None 且 Lock-Up Period 為 None 的只有 (B) Class C (Advisory)（Class D 已調整為有 5% 績效費與 6 個月鎖定期）。
• 誘答分析：(D) Class B 在對話中被提及管理費較低；(A)(C) 皆不符合無鎖定期與無績效費之限制。

questions.q: What constraint does the man mention about the client?
options: Its Geneva board requires a 12-month lock-up on credit funds.
Its governing body forbids compensation tied to investment gains.
The client refuses to pay any annual management fee above 1.25 percent.
The family office is unable to meet a $1 million minimum investment.

explain.text:
• 考點：限制條件題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士提到客戶的投資委員會禁止支付任何績效激勵費用（investment board prohibits paying any performance-based incentive fees），(B)「其決策機構禁止給付與投資報酬掛鉤的酬勞」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 $1 million，但客戶有 300 萬資金，遠高於門檻；(A) 出現原文 Geneva、12-month lock-up，與原意完全相反；(C) 出現原文 annual management fee、1.25 percent，未設此限制。

questions.q: What will the woman send to the client this afternoon?
options: A fee comparison chart for all four share classes
A DocuSign link for the Absolute Return Credit Fund's annual report
Official offering documents and enrollment paperwork
A revised liquidity schedule for the Geneva board

explain.text:
• 考點：行動細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士答應下午寄出私募備忘錄與認購協議（private placement memorandum and subscription agreement），(C)「正式募集說明文件與申購合約」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 share classes，非寄送內容；(D) 出現原文 Geneva board、liquidity，過度推論；(B) 出現原文 DocuSign、Absolute Return Credit Fund，但寄送的是認購文件而非年報。

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
options: Evaluating an automated tool to improve money-laundering monitoring
Replacing the compliance team with a machine-learning system
Adjusting bi-weekly international payroll schedules for mid-sized clients
Investigating 4,200 suspicious wire transfers from last month

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題（同義替換）。
• 解析：兩人討論目前反洗錢篩選系統誤報率過高，正在評估一個能過濾例行薪資模式的機器學習模組，(A)「評估一項改善洗錢防制監控的自動化工具」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 compliance team、machine-learning，過度推論要取代整個團隊；(D) 出現原文 4,200，其中 96% 為誤報而非真實洗錢；(C) 出現原文 bi-weekly international payroll、mid-sized clients，非討論調整發薪日。

questions.q: What problem does the woman point out about the current system?
options: It mistakes legitimate recurring salary payouts for illicit activity.
It delays international payroll batches until Tuesday morning.
It misses 96 percent of genuine money-laundering transactions.
It cannot process historical transaction data from last quarter.

explain.text:
• 考點：問題細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士指出現行規則引擎無法區分可疑拆單匯款與例行企業薪資，每次雙週發薪都會觸發人工審查（triggers a manual review），(A)「將合法的定期薪資發放誤判為異常交易」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 96 percent，是誤報率而非漏報率；(B) 出現原文 international payroll、Tuesday morning，週二早上是測試時間而非延遲發薪；(D) 出現原文 historical transaction data、last quarter，功能剛好相反。

questions.q: What do the speakers agree to do next week?
options: Ask mid-sized clients to test the new rule engine on Tuesday
Trial the proposed software on past transaction records
Clear last month's 4,200 manual alerts before running a pilot
Turn off the current anti-money laundering screening system

explain.text:
• 考點：共識行動題（同義替換）。
• 解析：兩人同意下週針對上一季歷史交易數據進行平行前導測試（parallel pilot test on last quarter's historical transaction data），(B)「以過往交易紀錄試運行擬議中的軟體」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 mid-sized clients、Tuesday，測試對象是歷史數據而非客戶；(C) 出現原文 4,200、manual alerts，未提先清空再測；(D) 出現原文 anti-money laundering screening system，過於極端。

questions.q: Who is the intended audience for this announcement?
options: Business account holders managing organizational cash flows
Treasury onboarding specialists at Apex Commercial Bank
Customers calling to cancel outgoing wire transfers
Individuals requesting printed monthly bank statements

explain.text:
• 考點：聽眾對象推論（同義替換）。
• 解析：公告開頭為「Apex 商業銀行企業資金部支援專線」，內容涉及企業資金入口網、電匯核准與日常現金管理，顯示對象為 (A)「管理組織現金流的企業帳戶持有人」（原文 corporate treasury clients 的同義改寫）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 treasury onboarding specialist，但那是提供支援的銀行人員而非聽眾；(D) 出現原文 downloading bank statements，但未提申請紙本帳單；(C) 出現原文 approving wire transfers，與取消匯款無關。

questions.q: What change is taking effect on November 1?
options: View-only accounting profiles will no longer have portal access.
An extra verification step will be required to sign in to the platform.
Wire transfers will require a phone call to a treasury specialist.
Six-digit passcodes will replace all existing corporate passwords.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：11 月 1 日起全面強制啟用多重要素驗證（multi-factor authentication），登入前須輸入六位數一次性密碼，(B)「登入平台時將需要額外的驗證步驟」為同義改寫（multi-factor authentication → extra verification step；portal logins → sign in to the platform）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 view-only accounting profiles，但系統是「包含」唯讀帳號都須驗證而非取消權限；(C) 出現原文 wire transfers、treasury specialist，誤導須打電話核准匯款；(D) 出現原文 six-digit passcode，但那是一次性驗證碼而非取代密碼。

questions.q: What are listeners advised to do before October 25?
options: Download the bank's authenticator app before approving transfers
Press 2 to update their daily cash management preferences
Confirm their contact numbers on file within the web system
Enroll all view-only accounting staff in SMS alerts

explain.text:
• 考點：建議行動題（同義替換）。
• 解析：所有授權資金用戶受建議在 10 月 25 日前於線上入口網確認其登記的手機號碼（verify their registered mobile phone numbers in the online portal），(C)「在網頁系統內確認其登記的聯絡電話」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 authenticator app、approving transfers，但未要求 10 月 25 日前下載；(B) 出現原文 press 2、daily cash management，按 2 是轉接專員；(D) 出現原文 view-only accounting、SMS，對象錯置。

questions.q: What is the main topic of the briefing?
options: Quarterly performance of the company's currency risk-management strategy
North American operating margin forecasts for Q4
New target collar rates for euro-denominated receivables
Unexpected losses at the Frankfurt subsidiary

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者開場明確表示要檢視第三季外匯避險成果（third-quarter foreign exchange hedging results），(A)「公司貨幣風險管理策略的季度表現」為精準同義改寫（foreign exchange hedging → currency risk-management strategy）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 North American operating margins、Q4，將 Q3 已發生的保護誤導為 Q4 預測；(D) 出現原文 Frankfurt subsidiary，但該子公司其實帶來匯兌收益而非虧損；(C) 出現原文 target collar rates、euro-denominated receivables，屬於局部細節。

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "The euro's unexpected rally caught several desks off guard"?
options: To criticize regional treasurers for leaving 40 percent of receivables unhedged
To explain why unprotected European sales lifted overall corporate profit
To warn that North American margins fell by $11.4 million
To suggest abandoning forward contracts in favor of currency tailwinds

explain.text:
• 考點：意圖題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者解釋由於法蘭克福子公司有 40% 歐元應收帳款未避險，歐元意外走強換算成美元後反而使合併獲利增加 1,140 萬美元，(B)「說明為何未避險的歐洲銷售額推升了整體企業獲利」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 regional treasurers、40 percent of receivables unhedged，語氣並非批評；(C) 出現原文 North American margins、$11.4 million，將獲利增加曲解為利潤下降；(D) 出現原文 forward contracts、currency tailwinds，講者明確提醒「不應依賴」匯率順風。

questions.q: What will happen immediately following the briefing?
options: Finance leads will gather to plan next quarter's hedging positions.
The speaker will distribute a summary of Q3 North American margins.
Regional teams will lock in 80 percent protection for European receivables.
The Frankfurt desk will report its Q3 U.S. dollar translation results.

explain.text:
• 考點：下一步行動題（同義替換）。
• 解析：簡報結束後，區域資金主管將立刻在 B 會議室開會檢視第四季遠期合約配置並鎖定區間匯率，(A)「財務主管將集會規劃下一季的避險部位」為同義改寫（regional treasurers → finance leads；Q4 forward contract allocations → next quarter's hedging positions）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 Frankfurt、Q3、U.S. dollar，動作無中生有；(B) 出現原文 Q3、North American margins，非後續行程；(C) 出現原文 80 percent、European receivables，將北美比例錯植到歐洲。

questions.q: Why is David calling Ms. Lin?
options: To inform her that Concur rejected her credit card authorization
To reschedule Friday's committee review for the investment banking division
To ask why her team traveled to London during the third quarter
To obtain detailed documentation needed to complete an internal review

explain.text:
• 考點：目的題（同義替換）。
• 解析：David 因正在進行第三季差旅費用稽核，發現林小姐團隊倫敦行程缺少明細憑證而來電索取，(D)「取得完成內部審查所需的詳細證明文件」為同義改寫（supporting documents → detailed documentation；expense audit → internal review）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 London、third quarter，並非詢問出差原因；(A) 出現原文 Concur、credit card authorization，系統並未退件；(B) 出現原文 Friday's committee review、investment banking division，未提改期。

questions.q: What issue does David mention regarding the travel receipts?
options: Lodging records show lump-sum totals without per-night or dining details.
Room rates and meal charges were billed to the wrong corporate card.
Several London hotel folios were never uploaded to Concur.
Credit card authorizations exceeded the corporate audit limit.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：David 指出上傳至 Concur 的飯店發票僅顯示信用卡授權總額，缺乏每晚房價與餐飲費用的明細（lack itemized breakdowns of nightly room rates and meal charges），(A)「住宿紀錄僅顯示總額而無每日房費或餐飲明細」為精準同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 room rates、meal charges，未提刷錯卡；(C) 出現原文 London、hotel folios、Concur，發票已上傳只是缺明細；(D) 出現原文 credit card authorizations、corporate audit，未提超額。

questions.q: By when does David need the corrected files?
options: By midday the following day
Before the end of the third quarter
Immediately after Ms. Lin contacts the hotel
By the end of the week

explain.text:
• 考點：時間細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：David 請林小姐在「明天中午前」（by noon tomorrow）上傳修正後的檔案，(A)「隔天正午之前」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D)「本週結束前」比原文要求的時間晚，David 要的是隔天中午；(B) 出現原文 third quarter，時間錯置；(C) 出現原文 contact the hotel，過於模糊且不符原意。

questions.q: What is the purpose of the training session?
options: To review qualitative audit findings from regional credit unions
To teach entry-level staff how to evaluate audit significance benchmarks
To compare pre-tax income across commercial banks and tech startups
To train junior associates on preparing client binder disclosures

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題（同義替換）。
• 解析：這場針對新進稽核員的下午場工作坊主題是「重大性門檻」（materiality thresholds），教導如何在規劃階段判斷重大性基準，(B)「教導初階人員如何評估稽核重大性基準」為同義改寫（new audit associates → entry-level staff；materiality thresholds → audit significance benchmarks）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 pre-tax income、commercial banks、tech startups，這些只是舉例對比對象；(A) 出現原文 qualitative、regional credit unions，信用合作社是分組練習標的；(D) 出現原文 junior associates、binders、disclosures，概念拼湊。

questions.q: According to the speaker, what mistake do junior staff frequently make?
options: Ignoring total revenue and total assets when auditing mature banks
Applying a 5 percent pre-tax income rule only to high-growth startups
Using an identical percentage standard regardless of a client's sector
Relying solely on qualitative factors rather than quantitative benchmarks

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者指出初階人員常犯的錯誤是「對所有客戶產業套用單一的重大性百分比」（applying a uniform materiality percentage... across all client industries），(C)「不論客戶所屬產業別皆套用相同的百分比標準」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 total revenue、total assets、mature banks，但營收與資產適用於新創而非成熟銀行；(D) 出現原文 qualitative factors、quantitative benchmarks，講者說兩者同等重要；(B) 出現原文 5 percent pre-tax income、high-growth startups，講者說新創「不適用」稅前淨利 5%。

questions.q: What will participants do next?
options: Calculate pre-tax income for a high-growth tech startup
Review a completed audit of a mature commercial bank
Collaborate in small teams to analyze a practice audit file
Present qualitative factors from their training binders

explain.text:
• 考點：下一步行動題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者接著請學員四人一組（break into small groups of four），檢視講義夾中的範例稽核底稿（examine the sample audit workpaper），(C)「以小組合作方式分析一份範例稽核檔案」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 pre-tax income、high-growth tech startup，練習標的是信用合作社；(D) 出現原文 qualitative factors、binders，未提上台報告；(B) 出現原文 mature commercial bank，對象錯置。

questions.q: What corporate event is the speaker reporting on?
options: An unsolicited acquisition attempt involving two banking firms
A merger agreement between Continental Financial Group and Horizon
An investigation into Horizon's wealth advisory profit reporting
A 14 percent drop in Horizon Regional Bancorp's share price

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題（同義替換）。
• 解析：新聞報導 Horizon 區域銀行正式拒絕 Continental 金融集團提出的 38 億美元非合意敵意收購要約（unsolicited $3.8 billion hostile takeover bid），(A)「兩家銀行機構間的非合意收購企圖」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 14 percent、Horizon Regional Bancorp，但股價是「大漲」14% 而非下跌；(B) 出現原文 Continental Financial Group、Horizon，但收購案已被拒絕而非達成協議；(C) 出現原文 Horizon、wealth advisory、profit，未提遭到調查。

questions.q: Why did the target company's board reject the initial offer?
options: Continental Financial Group offered stock instead of an all-cash payout.
Wall Street analysts advised Horizon to wait for a 14 percent higher bid.
Horizon's wealth advisory unit accounted for less than a third of profits.
The proposed price failed to reflect the true worth of a key business line.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因題（同義替換）。
• 解析：Horizon 董事會表示每股 42 美元的全現金報價嚴重低估了其快速成長的財富顧問部門價值（significantly undervalued its fast-growing wealth advisory unit），(D)「提案價格未能反映關鍵業務部門的真實價值」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 Continental Financial Group、all-cash，敘述與事實相反（報價正是全現金）；(C) 出現原文 wealth advisory unit、third of profits，說「少於」三分之一與「將近」三分之一語意有別且非拒絕理由；(B) 出現原文 Wall Street analysts、14 percent，數字錯置（14% 是股價漲幅，分析師預期加價 12%）。

questions.q: According to the report, what is expected to happen next week?
options: Horizon's board will issue a second strongly worded statement.
Both lenders will finalize negotiations at $42 per share.
The bidder is projected to submit a higher purchase proposal.
Continental's management will withdraw its $3.8 billion offer.

explain.text:
• 考點：未來預測題（同義替換）。
• 解析：華爾街分析師預期 Continental 下週初會提出更優渥的報價（return with a sweetened bid—raising its offer by roughly 12 percent），(C)「出價方預計將提出更高的收購報價」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 Horizon's board、strongly worded statement，那是本週已發生的事；(D) 出現原文 Continental's management、$3.8 billion，與分析師預期相反；(B) 出現原文 $42 per share，42 美元是已被拒絕的舊報價。

questions.q:
Look at the graphic. Which segment experienced the steepest year-over-year decline in operating margin?

Business Segment | FY25 Revenue | FY26 Revenue | FY25 Margin | FY26 Margin
Retail Banking | $420M | $438M | 24.5% | 22.0%
Corporate Lending | $310M | $345M | 31.0% | 30.2%
Wealth Advisory | $195M | $228M | 28.4% | 31.5%
Capital Markets | $160M | $142M | 19.8% | 14.1%
options: Corporate Lending
Wealth Advisory
Retail Banking
Capital Markets

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽線索＋看表格）。
• 解析：講者在獨白中刻意不唸出「Capital Markets」，而是給出線索「2026 會計年度營收最小的部門（our smallest revenue division in FY26）」且「營業利益率較去年同期縮水超過五個百分點」。對照表格，FY26 營收最小的是 $142M 的 (D) Capital Markets，且其營益率從 19.8% 降至 14.1%（下滑 5.7 個百分點，確實為最大跌幅）。
• 誘答分析：(B) Wealth Advisory 在獨白中被正面表揚；(C)(A) 營收皆高於 $300M 且營益率跌幅遠小於五個百分點。

questions.q: What does the speaker attribute that segment's performance to?
options: Lower balance sheet liquidity over the past twelve months
A decline in net new asset inflows during fiscal year 2026
Corporate issuers shifting capital into Retail Banking
Reduced transaction activity caused by high borrowing costs

explain.text:
• 考點：原因細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者指出該部門利潤下滑主因是「高利率環境下交易量減少」（lower deal volume amid elevated interest rates），使企業發行人觀望，(D)「高借貸成本導致交易活動減少」為同義改寫（elevated interest rates → high borrowing costs；lower deal volume → reduced transaction activity）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 net new asset inflows、FY2026，那是財富顧問部門表現亮眼的原因；(C) 出現原文 corporate issuers、Retail Banking，原文並未提及轉向零售銀行；(A) 出現原文 balance sheet liquidity、twelve months，講者明確說流動性「極佳」。

questions.q: What does the speaker announce regarding the company's capital allocation?
options: Distributing $150 million in special dividends next quarter
Using excess liquidity to acquire corporate issuers
Launching a new Wealth Advisory product in FY2027
Increasing funds authorized for buying back company stock

explain.text:
• 考點：公告細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：董事會投票決定在未來 12 個月內將「庫藏股買回授權額度擴大 1.5 億美元」（expand our share repurchase authorization by $150 million），(D)「增加授權用於買回公司股票的資金」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 Wealth Advisory、FY2027，未提推出新產品；(A) 出現原文 $150 million，將庫藏股金額誤導為特別股利；(B) 出現原文 liquidity、corporate issuers，未提併購發行人。

questions.q: What phase of the merger is the speaker discussing?
options: Auditing client billing records before the deal closes
Eliminating redundant 90-day HR milestones
Initial operational alignment immediately following deal closure
Finalizing the purchase agreement for Veridian Systems

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者開場表示 Veridian Systems 收購案今早正式完成交割，現在進入「交割後第一天整合階段」（Day-One post-closing integration），(C)「交易完成後隨即展開的初期營運整併」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 Veridian Systems，但收購案已經完成交割；(A) 出現原文 client billing，但這是整併期間要避免中斷的業務；(B) 出現原文 90-day，並非要「刪除」里程碑。

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "Dual payroll systems are a recipe for audit exceptions"?
options: To stress the need to unify human resources and finance software quickly
To criticize controllers for running two chart-of-accounts structures
To justify delaying internal control testing for 90 days
To explain why Veridian Systems experienced client billing errors

explain.text:
• 考點：意圖題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者說「雙軌薪資系統是稽核異常的溫床」，緊接著強調必須儘快整合人資與會計平台（consolidate HR and accounting platforms as quickly as possible），(A)「強調必須迅速統一核人資與財務軟體」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 Veridian Systems、client billing，未提已發生帳單錯誤；(C) 出現原文 internal controls、90 days，說法相反；(B) 出現原文 controllers、two chart-of-accounts structures，語氣並非指責財務長。

questions.q: What milestone is scheduled for the end of Q1?
options: Combining all accounting ledgers into one unified enterprise system
Hiring external auditors to review the unified chart of accounts
Completing client billing integration within the first 90 days
Training controllers on Veridian Systems' existing payroll platform

explain.text:
• 考點：里程碑細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：第一季末的重大里程碑是「將所有總分類帳科目遷移至單一 ERP 實例」（migrating all general ledger accounts onto a single ERP instance），(A)「將所有會計總帳整合進單一企業系統」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 client billing、90 days，時間與項目錯置；(D) 出現原文 controllers、Veridian Systems、payroll，與整合方向相反；(B) 出現原文 chart of accounts，未提聘請外部稽核。

questions.q: What service is being advertised?
options: A multi-currency bank portal built for Monday morning audits
A web-hosted liquidity management platform for finance executives
A high-yield savings sweep account offered by 2,500 global banks
A consulting service that forecasts idle cash for small businesses

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題（同義替換）。
• 解析：廣告推銷「為現代財務長打造的雲端資金與現金可視性平台」（cloud-based treasury and cash-visibility platform built for modern CFOs），(B)「供財務高階主管使用的雲端流動性管理平台」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 bank portal、Monday mornings，週一早上是客戶目前的痛點；(C) 出現原文 2,500 global banks，平台是串接銀行而非銀行提供的定存帳戶；(D) 出現原文 forecasts idle cash，廣告標的為軟體平台而非顧問服務。

questions.q: What feature of the service is highlighted?
options: Guaranteed higher interest income on idle cash balances
Automated Monday morning logins across twelve separate bank portals
Free daily sweeps to over 2,500 global partner banks
Instant aggregation of account figures across multiple institutions and currencies

explain.text:
• 考點：產品特色題（同義替換）。
• 解析：平台連接全球 2,500 多家銀行，在單一儀表板中提供「跨幣別多銀行餘額的即時整合」（real-time consolidation of multi-bank balances across all currencies），(D)「跨機構與跨幣別帳戶數據的即時彙整」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 Monday mornings、twelve separate bank portals，那是未導入系統前的舊做法；(A) 出現原文 interest income、idle cash balances，廣告僅說可試算潛在收益，未「保證」提高；(C) 出現原文 daily sweeps、2,500 global banks，未提免費。

questions.q: How can listeners receive a customized ROI assessment?
options: By running a liquidity forecast on treasurypulse.com
By calling a TreasuryPulse finance specialist directly
By linking twelve bank accounts through the software tool
By scheduling a brief online product demonstration

explain.text:
• 考點：行動細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：廣告指示聽眾今天上官網預約 20 分鐘即時示範（Book a 20-minute live demo on our website），即可獲得客製化 ROI 評估，(D)「透過預約簡短的線上產品演示」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 twelve bank accounts、software tool，過度簡化步驟；(B) 出現原文 TreasuryPulse、finance，未提供電話專線；(A) 出現原文 liquidity forecast、treasurypulse.com，網頁是預約示範而非直接跑預測。

questions.q:
Look at the graphic. Which bond rating category is the speaker recommending for conservative income portfolios?

Credit Rating | Yield to Maturity | 5-Year Default Rate | Duration (Years)
AAA (Sovereign/Prime) | 4.15% | 0.02% | 6.8
A (Investment Grade) | 4.85% | 0.45% | 5.4
BBB (Lower Investment) | 5.60% | 1.85% | 5.1
BB (High Yield) | 7.40% | 6.90% | 3.9
options: AAA (Sovereign/Prime)
A (Investment Grade)
BBB (Lower Investment)
BB (High Yield)

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽線索＋看表格）。
• 解析：講者刻意不唸出「A (Investment Grade)」，而是給出雙重篩選線索：「五年違約率低於 0.5%（under half a percent）」且「殖利率高於 4.5%（above 4.5 percent）」。對照圖表，AAA 殖利率僅 4.15%（低於 4.5%），BBB 與 BB 違約率皆高於 0.5%（1.85% 與 6.90%），唯一同時符合兩項條件的是 (B) A (Investment Grade)（殖利率 4.85%、違約率 0.45%）。
• 誘答分析：(D) BB 在獨白中被明確警告風險；(A)(C) 皆僅符合其中一項條件，必須交叉比對才能排除。

questions.q: Why does the speaker advise caution regarding BB-rated bonds?
options: Their 7.4 percent yield fails to offset a 6.90 percent annual default rate.
Issuers face steeper debt-rollover expenses if market risk premiums expand.
Conservative clients are prohibited from buying high-yield corporate bonds.
Their 5-year historical default rate is higher during economic booms.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者警告 BB 級發行人面臨嚴重的再融資風險：若經濟放緩導致信用利差擴大，其借貸成本會急劇上升（borrowing costs rise sharply if credit spreads widen），(B)「若市場風險溢酬擴大，發行人將面臨更陡峭的借新還舊成本」為同義改寫（refinancing → debt-rollover；credit spreads → market risk premiums）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 7.4 percent yield、6.90 percent default rate，但 6.90% 是五年累計違約率而非年違約率；(D) 出現原文 5-year historical default rate，講者說的是經濟放緩（slowdown）而非繁榮期；(C) 出現原文 conservative clients、high-yield，過度推論為「禁止」。

questions.q: What does the speaker offer to distribute at the end of the seminar?
options: A chart comparing 5-year default rates across bond categories
A registration form for an upcoming corporate bond workshop
A hard-copy research report covering fourth-quarter debt markets
A guide on building a conservative income portfolio

explain.text:
• 考點：結尾細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者請聽眾離開前到報到桌領取公司「第四季固定收益展望的紙本」（a printed copy of our firm's Q4 fixed-income outlook），(C)「涵蓋第四季債市的紙本研調報告」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 5-year default rates，非發放文件；(D) 出現原文 conservative income portfolio，非指南手冊；(B) 出現原文 registration，registration table 是領取地點而非報名表。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the voicemail?
options: To notify Marcus that four branches failed their annual compliance audit
To explain why Evelyn placed Marcus's district on the exception list
To prompt local office heads to turn in periodic regulatory filings
To announce a new Friday 5:00 P.M. deadline for Q3 staff training

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題（同義替換）。
• 解析：Evelyn 留言給各區分行經理，提醒尚未繳交第三季反洗錢（AML）訓練與交易監控證明（quarterly anti-money laundering certifications），(C)「催促地方分行主管繳交定期法遵申報文件」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 Marcus、four branches、annual compliance，尚未到稽核失敗階段；(D) 出現原文 Friday 5:00 P.M.、Q3 training，週五下午五點是認證繳交期限而非新設訓練期限；(B) 出現原文 Evelyn、Marcus's district、exception list，語氣並非解釋為何列入名單，而是催交以解除名單。

questions.q: What will happen if a branch misses the Friday deadline?
options: The branch manager will be removed from transaction-monitoring duties.
Corporate Compliance will suspend Q3 training for that branch.
An official noncompliance record will be filed with internal reviewers.
All four branches in the district will receive lower annual ratings.

explain.text:
• 考點：條件結果題（同義替換）。
• 解析：若任何分行錯過週五期限，將向內部稽核登錄正式缺失通知（a formal deficiency notice will be logged with internal audit），(C)「將向內部審查單位呈報正式的未合規紀錄」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 branch manager、transaction-monitoring，未提停職；(B) 出現原文 Corporate Compliance、Q3 training，動作無中生有；(D) 出現原文 four branches、annual ratings，只有「逾期未交」的分行受影響，並非全區四家都受罰。

questions.q: What does the speaker ask the recipient to do?
options: Remind the four branch managers to sign off before 5:00 P.M.
Email the executed verification document to the compliance team
Contact internal audit to clear the district off the exception list
Upload Q3 transaction-monitoring logs to the compliance portal

explain.text:
• 考點：請求行動題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者請收件人在經理簽核後，將簽署好的證明 PDF 直接轉寄至法遵收件匣（forward the signed attestation PDF directly to the compliance inbox），(B)「將已簽署的驗證文件以電子郵件寄給法遵團隊」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 four branch managers、sign off、5:00 P.M.，要求的是寄送 PDF 而非催促前打電話回報；(C) 出現原文 internal audit、exception list，聯絡對象是法遵而非內部稽核；(D) 出現原文 Q3 transaction-monitoring、compliance，未提上傳至入口網。

questions.q: The audit committee insisted that the external accounting firm ------- all off-balance-sheet liabilities before signing off on the annual report.
options: disclose
discloses
disclosing
disclosed

explain.text:
• 考點：堅持／要求動詞後的假設語氣（Subjunctive Mood）。
• 解析：主要動詞 insisted 後接 that 名詞子句，表達「強烈要求」，子句動詞須用原形動詞（省略 should），故選 (A) disclose。
• 誘答分析：(B) 第三人稱單數現在式、(D) 過去式、(C) 分詞，均不符合假設語氣規則。
• 單字補充：off-balance-sheet liabilities（表外負債）、sign off on（簽核批准）。

questions.q: ------- the central bank's unexpected 50-basis-point rate hike, corporate bond issuance remained surprisingly robust throughout the third quarter.
options: Pertaining to
Inasmuch as
Provided that
Notwithstanding

explain.text:
• 考點：讓步介系詞 vs. 連接詞辨析。
• 解析：空格後接名詞片語 "the central bank's unexpected 50-basis-point rate hike"（無動詞），須填介系詞；語意為「儘管央行意外升息 50 個基點，企業債發行仍出奇強勁」，故選 (D) Notwithstanding（儘管，= Despite）。
• 誘答分析：(C) Provided that（倘若）、(B) Inasmuch as（因為）皆為連接詞須接子句；(A) Pertaining to（關於）語意不符。
• 單字補充：basis point（基點，1 bps = 0.01%）、corporate bond issuance（公司債發行）。

questions.q: Under the revised Basel III framework, commercial banks must maintain a higher tier-one capital ratio to ------- potential credit losses during economic downturns.
options: forfeit
absorb
disperse
inflate

explain.text:
• 考點：金融字彙動詞辨析。
• 解析：銀行在巴塞爾協定 III（Basel III）下維持較高的第一類資本適足率，目的是「吸收（absorb）」經濟衰退期間潛在的信用損失，故選 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(C) disperse（驅散／分發）、(A) forfeit（喪失／沒收）、(D) inflate（膨脹）。
• 單字補充：tier-one capital ratio（第一類資本比率）、credit losses（信用損失）。

questions.q: Had the acquiring company conducted a more thorough environmental due diligence, it ------- the undisclosed remediation liabilities prior to closing.
options: would uncover
had uncovered
will have uncovered
would have uncovered

explain.text:
• 考點：與過去事實相反的假設語氣倒裝（Had + S + Vpp, S + would have + Vpp）。
• 解析：句首 "Had the acquiring company conducted..." 為 If it had conducted 的倒裝，主句表達過去未發生的結果，須用 would have + Vpp，故選 (D)。
• 誘答分析：(A) 與現在事實相反、(C) 未來完成式、(B) 過去完成式，時態皆不合。
• 單字補充：remediation liabilities（環境整治負債）、prior to closing（交割前）。

questions.q: All wire transfers exceeding $250,000 require dual ------- from both the treasury director and an authorized compliance officer.
options: authorization
authorize
authoritatively
authoritative

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性辨析（名詞）。
• 解析：及物動詞 require 後須接名詞作受詞，且前面有形容詞 dual（雙重的）修飾，故選名詞 (A) authorization（授權）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 動詞、(D) 形容詞（權威的）、(C) 副詞。
• 單字補充：dual authorization（雙重授權）、compliance officer（法遵專員）。

questions.q: The investment firm's ------- of its logistics subsidiary generated $420 million in net proceeds, which were immediately used to pay down existing debt.
options: budget
delay
purchase
sale

explain.text:
• 考點：商務字彙名詞辨析。
• 解析：句意指投資公司「出售（sale）」其物流子公司，產生 4.2 億美元淨收益用於償還現有債務，故選 (D)。
• 誘答分析：(C) purchase（購買）、(B) delay（延遲）、(A) budget（預算）。
• 單字補充：subsidiary（子公司）、net proceeds（淨收益）。

questions.q: ------- in 1998 as a boutique advisory firm, Halcyon Capital now manages over $18 billion in institutional fixed-income assets.
options: Founding
Founded
Having founded
To found

explain.text:
• 考點：分詞構句（被動語態省略）。
• 解析：主句主詞為 Halcyon Capital，公司是「被創立（Founded in 1998）」，原句為 As it was founded in 1998，省略連接詞與 be 動詞後保留過去分詞 (B) Founded。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C) 主動分詞、(D) 不定詞表目的，邏輯皆不合。
• 單字補充：boutique advisory firm（精品財務顧問公司）、fixed-income assets（固定收益資產）。

questions.q: Please ensure that the updated property valuation is uploaded to the virtual data room ------- than 4:00 P.M. Eastern Time on Friday.
options: not late
the latest
no later
any later

explain.text:
• 考點：時間截止慣用語。
• 解析：表達「不晚於週五下午四點」，固定搭配為 no later than，故選 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(B) 均無法與 than 構成正確截止時間片語。
• 單字補充：property valuation（資產鑑價）、virtual data room（虛擬資料室）。

questions.q: The merger agreement contains a strict material adverse change clause, ------- the buyer to walk away if the target's revenue drops by more than 15 percent.
options: permitted
permission
permitting
permits

explain.text:
• 考點：分詞構句（非限定用法修飾整句／先行詞）。
• 解析：逗點後缺乏連接詞，須用現在分詞 (C) permitting（= which permits）作補充說明，表示「這項條款允許買方退出」。
• 誘答分析：(D) 原形／現在式動詞會造成雙動詞無連接詞錯誤、(A) 被動不合、(B) 名詞無動詞功能。
• 單字補充：material adverse change (MAC) clause（重大不利變更條款）。

questions.q: Because the borrower failed to meet the debt-service coverage ratio ------- in Section 7.2 of the credit agreement, the lender declared a technical default.
options: solicited
stipulated
speculated
simulated

explain.text:
• 考點：合約金融字彙過去分詞辨析。
• 解析：表示信用協議第 7.2 條中「明文規定的（stipulated）」償債覆蓋率，故選 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(C) speculated（推測）、(D) simulated（模擬）、(A) solicited（招攬／徵求）。
• 單字補充：debt-service coverage ratio (DSCR)（償債覆蓋率）、technical default（技術性違約）。

questions.q: ------- the arrangement of the short-term loan is completed, the lead arrangers will distribute the final allocation notices to participating banks.
options: Whereas
As soon as
In case of
Even though

explain.text:
• 考點：時間副詞連接詞辨析。
• 解析：主句使用未來式 will distribute，搭配從屬子句現在被動式 is completed，「一等過橋貸款銀團籌組完成，主辦行就會寄發最終分配通知」，故選 (B) As soon as。
• 誘答分析：(D) 雖然、(A) 然而、(C) 介系詞片語不可接完整子句。
• 單字補充：arrangement（籌組安排）、short-term loan（短期貸款）。

questions.q: Forensic accountants discovered that several vendor payments had been ------- to shell companies registered in overseas locations.
options: diverted
accrued
redeemed
convened

explain.text:
• 考點：財務舞弊字彙動詞辨析。
• 解析：鑑識會計師發現數筆廠商款項被「轉移／挪用（diverted）」至離岸空殼公司，故選 (A)。
• 誘答分析：(D) convened（召開）、(C) redeemed（贖回）、(B) accrued（應計／累積）。
• 單字補充：shell company（空殼公司）、overseas location（海外地區）。

questions.q: Neither the chief financial officer nor the regional controllers ------- aware of the unrecorded inventory write-down until the internal audit concluded.
options: were
is being
has been
was

explain.text:
• 考點：Neither A nor B 的主謂一致（就近原則）。
• 解析：Neither... nor... 連接兩個主詞時，動詞須與較近的主詞 regional controllers（複數）一致，且時間為過去式（until... concluded），故選 (A) were。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(B) 皆為單數動詞，誤受 CFO 干擾。
• 單字補充：inventory write-down（存貨跌價損失／減損）。

questions.q: Investors reacted positively to the bank's ------- of non-performing loans, sending its share price up 4.3 percent in early trading.
options: markup
write-off
overhang
spillover

explain.text:
• 考點：銀行財務複合名詞辨析。
• 解析：銀行將不良貸款「沖銷／呆帳打銷（write-off）」，改善資產負債表體質，帶動股價早盤上漲，故選 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(A) markup（加價幅度）、(C) overhang（懸置賣壓）、(D) spillover（外溢效應）。
• 單字補充：non-performing loans (NPLs)（不良貸款／逾放款）。

questions.q: The wealth management division offers customized estate planning strategies tailored ------- high-net-worth individuals with cross-border tax exposure.
options: into
upon
to
among

explain.text:
• 考點：固定介系詞搭配。
• 解析：be tailored to + 對象 意為「為……量身打造」，為多益超高頻搭配，故選 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(B) 皆非 tailored 的標準介系詞搭配。
• 單字補充：estate planning（遺產／財富傳承規劃）、high-net-worth individuals（高淨值人士）。

questions.q: Because the quarterly earnings report ------- ahead of schedule, the investor relations team had extra time to prepare for analyst questions.
options: has publishing
was published
to publish
publishes

explain.text:
• 考點：動詞時態與被動語態。
• 解析：主詞為「季度財報（the quarterly earnings report）」，與「發布（publish）」之間為被動關係，且由主句動詞 had 可知為過去時間，故選過去被動式 (B) was published。
• 誘答分析：(D) 主動第三人稱單數不合語意、(A) 文法錯誤、(C) 不定詞無法作謂語動詞。
• 單字補充：ahead of schedule（提前）、investor relations（投資人關係）。

questions.q: To avoid conflicts of interest, independent directors are strictly ------- from holding equity stakes in any competing financial institution.
options: precluded
reconciled
expedited
endorsed

explain.text:
• 考點：金融合規字彙動詞辨析。
• 解析：為避免利益衝突，獨立董事被嚴格「禁止／排除（precluded from）」持有競爭金融機構的股權，故選 (A)。
• 誘答分析：(D) endorsed（背書）、(C) expedited（加速）、(B) reconciled（調節／和解）。
• 單字補充：conflict of interest（利益衝突）、equity stake（股權）。

questions.q: The advisory fee is ------- upon the successful completion of the initial public offering and will be deducted directly from the gross proceeds.
options: immune
adjacent
contingent
redundant

explain.text:
• 考點：合約條件形容詞搭配。
• 解析：contingent upon 意為「視……而定／取決於……」，承銷費取決於 IPO 是否成功完成，故選 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(B) adjacent（鄰近的，搭 to）、(A) immune（免疫的，搭 to/from）、(D) redundant（冗餘的）。
• 單字補充：gross proceeds（募集總金額）。

questions.q: Ms. Takahashi's promotion to Senior Vice President of Risk Management was well deserved, given her ------- track record in stress-testing investment portfolios.
options: exemplify
exemplarily
exemplary
exemplification

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性辨析（形容詞修飾名詞片語）。
• 解析：空格位於所有格 her 與名詞 track record 之間，須填形容詞 (C) exemplary（典範的／卓越的）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 動詞、(D) 名詞、(B) 副詞。
• 單字補充：stress-testing（壓力測試）、investment portfolio（投資組合）。

questions.q: ------- how volatile emerging-market currencies have been this year, our treasury desk has hedged 85 percent of projected foreign receivables.
options: Unless
Suppose
Albeit
Given

explain.text:
• 考點：介系詞／分詞連接詞用法。
• 解析：Given + 名詞／how 名詞子句 意為「考量到／鑑於……」，後方接 how volatile... have been 這整個名詞子句，故選 (D) Given。
• 誘答分析：(B) Suppose（假設）、(A) Unless（除非）、(C) Albeit（儘管，後多接形容詞或片語），語意與結構皆不合。
• 單字補充：emerging-market currencies（新興市場貨幣）、receivables（應收帳款）。

questions.q: The fund manager must act in a ------- manner at all times, prioritizing the long-term financial interests of pension clients over short-term commissions.
options: reluctant
temporary
casual
responsible

explain.text:
• 考點：商務字彙形容詞辨析。
• 解析：基金經理人必須始終以「負責任的（responsible）」態度行事，將退休金客戶的長期財務利益置於短期佣金之上，故選 (D)。
• 誘答分析：(B) temporary（暫時的）、(A) reluctant（勉強的）、(C) casual（隨意的）。
• 單字補充：prioritize（優先考量）、commission（佣金）。

questions.q: Should any material discrepancy ------- during the physical inventory count, the field auditor must document it immediately in the exception log.
options: arises
arose
arise
arising

explain.text:
• 考點：條件句倒裝（Should + S + 原形動詞）。
• 解析：句首為假設未來可能發生情況的倒裝句型（= If any material discrepancy should arise），故動詞須用原形 (C) arise。
• 誘答分析：(A) 現在單數、(B) 過去式、(D) 現在分詞，均不合 Should 倒裝結構。
• 單字補充：exception log（異常紀錄簿）。

questions.q: The newly enacted anti-money laundering directive applies ------- to domestic retail banks and foreign branches operating within the European Union.
options: equalize
equal
equality
equally

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性辨析（副詞修飾動詞）。
• 解析：修飾不及物動詞 applies（適用），須用副詞 (D) equally（同等地）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 形容詞、(C) 名詞、(A) 動詞。
• 單字補充：directive（歐盟指令）、domestic（國內的）。

questions.q: In light of the protracted regulatory review, both companies agreed to extend the ------- date of the merger agreement by an additional 90 days.
options: terminal
terminate
terminating
termination

explain.text:
• 考點：複合名詞搭配。
• 解析：併購合約中的「終止日期／截止日」固定為 termination date，故選 (D)。
• 誘答分析：(B) 動詞、(A) 形容詞（末期的／航廈）、(C) 分詞。
• 單字補充：protracted（曠日廢時的）、regulatory review（監管審查）。

questions.q: The bond's coupon rate is fixed at 5.25 percent; -------, its market price will fluctuate inversely with prevailing interest rates.
options: otherwise
specifically
nevertheless
likewise

explain.text:
• 考點：轉折副詞邏輯辨析。
• 解析：前句說債券票面利率固定在 5.25%，後句說其市場價格仍會隨現行利率反向波動，前後呈轉折關係，故選 (C) nevertheless（然而／儘管如此）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 同樣地、(A) 否則、(B) 具體而言。
• 單字補充：coupon rate（票面利率）、inversely（反向地）。

questions.q: Before approving the company acquisition, the credit committee scrutinized the target's ability to generate sufficient free cash flow to ------- its debt obligations.
options: service
defer
waive
incur

explain.text:
• 考點：金融專業動詞搭配（service debt）。
• 解析：service debt / debt obligations 為財金核心搭配詞，意為「償付債務本息」，故選 (A)。
• 誘答分析：(D) incur（招致／承擔債務，與 generate cash flow to... 語意相反）、(C) waive（豁免）、(B) defer（延後）。
• 單字補充：company acquisition（企業收購）、free cash flow（自由現金流）。

questions.q: All supporting schedules for the consolidated tax return must be retained in secure electronic archives for ------- seven years following the filing date.
options: at least
on behalf of
by far
at most

explain.text:
• 考點：數量詞片語辨析。
• 解析：法規要求財稅底稿必須保存「至少（at least）」七年，故選 (A)。
• 誘答分析：(D) 至多、(C) 迄今最……、(B) 代表……。
• 單字補充：consolidated tax return（合併報稅申報書）。

questions.q: The fintech startup's Series C funding round was ------- oversubscribed, prompting management to increase the total capital raise from $60 million to $85 million.
options: narrowly
scarcely
barely
heavily

explain.text:
• 考點：副詞與形容詞搭配（heavily oversubscribed）。
• 解析：後文提到管理層把募資總額從六千萬調高到八千五百萬美元，可見 C 輪融資被「大幅／嚴重（heavily）」超額認購，故選 (D)。
• 誘答分析：(A) narrowly（勉強地）、(B) scarcely（幾乎不）、(C) barely（僅僅），皆與調高募資額的語意矛盾。
• 單字補充：oversubscribed（超額認購的）。

questions.q: By the time the external examiners arrive next Monday, the internal compliance team ------- all remedial actions listed in the corrective plan.
options: had been completing
will have completed
will complete
has completed

explain.text:
• 考點：未來完成式時態（By the time + 現在式, S + will have + Vpp）。
• 解析：By the time 後接現在式 arrive 表未來時間點，主句表達「到下週一檢查員抵達前，團隊將已完成所有補救措施」，須用未來完成式 (B) will have completed。
• 誘答分析：(C) 單純未來式（較不精確，多益標準考點必選未來完成式）、(D) 現在完成式、(A) 過去完成進行式。
• 單字補充：remedial actions（補救措施）。

questions.q: ------- between the acquirer's legal counsel and the seller's representatives continued late into the night to finalize the compensation limit.
options: Negotiating
Negotiations
Negotiate
Negotiable

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性辨析（複數名詞作主詞）。
• 解析：句中缺主詞，between A and B 修飾主詞，(B) Negotiations（談判／協商）符合「雙方代表之間的協商持續到深夜」之語意與文法；(A) Negotiating 後通常直接接受詞而不接 between。
• 誘答分析：(C) 動詞、(D) 形容詞、(A) 動名詞較少與 between... and... 連用為主詞。
• 單字補充：compensation limit（賠償上限）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (131).
options: requirement
requiring
required
require

explain.text:
• 考點：分詞構句（結果補充說明）。
• 解析：逗點前為完整子句，逗點後無連接詞，以現在分詞 (B) requiring（= which requires）表示「這項調升要求借款人展現更強的營業收益」。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C) 有限定動詞問題或被動錯誤、(A) 名詞。
• 單字補充：loan-to-value (LTV) ratio（貸款成數）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (132).
options: Consequently, retail branch tellers will receive additional training on counterfeit detection.
However, residential mortgage rates are expected to remain unchanged until the spring quarter.
Borrowers may alternatively apply for an unsecured personal line of credit at any local branch.
These stricter limits are designed to insulate the bank's balance sheet from further valuation declines.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題（上下文連貫）。
• 解析：前句說明下調 B 級商辦的最高貸款成數（LTV）至 60%，(D)「這些更嚴格的上限旨在保護銀行資產負債表免於估值進一步下跌」精準承接前文的「stricter limits」。
• 誘答分析：(A) 分行櫃員防偽鈔訓練、(B) 住宅房貸利率、(C) 無擔保個人信貸，皆與商辦授信政策無關。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (133).
options: Unless
Whereas
In the event that
Should

explain.text:
• 考點：條件連接詞與動詞單複數一致性。
• 解析：空格後接主詞 any loan package 與第三人稱單數現在式動詞 lacks，故須選連接詞片語 (C) In the event that（倘若／萬一）。
• 誘答分析：(D) Should 倒裝後方必須接原形動詞 lack，不可接 lacks；(A) Unless（除非）、(B) Whereas（然而）語意皆不合。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (134).
options: criteria
receipts
dividends
tariffs

explain.text:
• 考點：名詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：現有額度在 12 月 31 日前常規續約者，將依循先前的「標準／準則（criteria）」評估，故選 (A)。
• 誘答分析：(C) 股利、(D) 關稅、(B) 收據。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (135).
options: mandating
mandated
mandate
mandatory

explain.text:
• 考點：as + 過去分詞（被動省略結構）。
• 解析：完整寫法為 as (it is) mandated by your standard sales contracts，表示「正如貴公司標準銷售合約所規定」，故選過去分詞 (B) mandated。
• 誘答分析：(A) 主動分詞、(C) 原形／名詞、(D) 形容詞（不可接 by...）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (136).
options: Our firm also provides executive search services for manufacturing clients across Pennsylvania.
The warehouse staff should therefore double-check all shipping labels prior to carrier pickup.
This timing difference does not comply with current accounting standards under ASC 606.
As a result, your company's share price rose sharply on the New York Stock Exchange.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題。
• 解析：前句指出客戶在出貨時即認列收入而非等客戶驗收，(C)「這項時間差異不符合 ASC 606 現行會計準則」直接點出會計違規，並引出後文「建議作調整分錄遞延 140 萬美元收入」。
• 誘答分析：(A) 獵頭服務、(B) 倉庫貼標籤、(D) 股價大漲，皆離題。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (137).
options: depreciation
fluctuation
appreciation
speculation

explain.text:
• 考點：會計專業名詞搭配。
• 解析：固定資產搭配的報表是「折舊（depreciation）」明細表（fixed-asset depreciation schedule），故選 (A)。
• 誘答分析：(C) appreciation（增值）、(D) speculation（投機）、(B) fluctuation（波動）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (138).
options: unqualified
unverified
understated
disqualified

explain.text:
• 考點：審計專業形容詞搭配。
• 解析：會計師查核無誤後簽發的是「無保留意見（unqualified audit opinion）」，此為審計學最高等級的乾淨意見，故選 (A)。
• 誘答分析：(D) 喪失資格的、(B) 未經證實的、(C) 低估的。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (139).
options: representative
representing
represented
represent

explain.text:
• 考點：分詞構句。
• 解析：前句說明支付 3.4 億美元現金與 1.1 億美元股票，逗點後以現在分詞 (B) representing（= which represents）補充「代表總企業價值 4.5 億美元」。
• 誘答分析：(C) 被動不合、(A) 形容詞／名詞、(D) 原形動詞。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (140).
options: Retail banking customers will still be able to use ATMs without paying out-of-network fees.
Quarterly dividend payments for preferred shareholders were distributed last Tuesday.
Aurelia recently relocated its European trading desk from Frankfurt to Zurich.
Horizon's existing offices in Seattle and Portland will serve as Aurelia's new regional hubs.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題。
• 解析：前句提到此收購大幅拓展在太平洋西北地區（Pacific Northwest）的版圖，(D)「Horizon 位於西雅圖與波特蘭的現有辦公室將成為 Aurelia 新的區域中心」在地理位置上完全呼應。
• 誘答分析：(C) 法蘭克福／蘇黎世、(A) ATM 跨行手續費、(B) 特別股季股利，皆不連貫。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (141).
options: contrary to
regardless of
in lieu of
subject to

explain.text:
• 考點：合約條件介系詞片語。
• 解析：併購預計明年第二季完成，「須視……而定（subject to）」慣例監管核准與反壟斷審查，故選 (D)。
• 誘答分析：(B) 不顧、(A) 與……相反、(C) 代替。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (142).
options: accretive
punitive
negligible
stagnant

explain.text:
• 考點：併購財務形容詞辨析。
• 解析：管理層預估合併後 12 個月內將對調整後每股盈餘產生「增益／增厚效果（accretive）」，即 EPS 提升，故選 (A)。
• 誘答分析：(B) punitive（懲罰性的）、(C) negligible（微不足道的）、(D) stagnant（停滯的）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (143).
options: attract
attractive
attractively
attractiveness

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性辨析（形容詞修飾名詞）。
• 解析：空格修飾複數名詞 yields（殖利率），須填形容詞 (B) attractive（具吸引力的）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 副詞、(D) 名詞、(A) 動詞。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (144).
options: Shareholders should therefore expect their annual tax forms to arrive by mail in late April.
The Fund's custodian bank recently opened a new retail branch in downtown Chicago.
Conversely, equity index funds experienced record outflows during the same period.
Currency exposure from these non-dollar holdings will continue to be fully hedged back into U.S. dollars.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題。
• 解析：前文討論將新興市場主權債上限從 15% 調高至 25%，(D)「這些非美元部位的匯率曝險將繼續完全避險回美元」直接補充投資人最關心的外匯風險控管，與後文信用評等下限形成完整風控說明。
• 誘答分析：(A) 四月寄稅單、(C) 股票指數基金資金外流、(B) 芝加哥開分行，皆不連貫。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (145).
options: Nevertheless
Otherwise
Furthermore
For instance

explain.text:
• 考點：轉折／遞進副詞辨析。
• 解析：前段剛講完擴大投資彈性，本段接著宣布「此外（Furthermore）」，年度管理費將調降 5 個基點，屬正面遞進訊息，故選 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(A) 然而、(D) 例如、(B) 否則。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (146).
options: because
since
unless
although

explain.text:
• 考點：條件連接詞辨析。
• 解析：句意為「您不需採取任何行動，除非（unless）您希望在生效日前贖回股份」，故選 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(A) 因為、(D) 雖然、(B) 自從／因為。

questions.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
options: To inform business account holders about an upcoming payment verification rule
To require authorized signatories to submit all instructions at a local branch
To introduce an upgraded online treasury portal for domestic wires
To alert clients that wire settlement delays will begin on November 22

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題（同義替換）。
• 解析：公告通知企業資金客戶，12 月 1 日起超過 5 萬美元的電匯須執行「帶外回撥驗證協議」以防範詐欺，(A)「通知企業帳戶持有人即將實施的付款驗證規定」為同義改寫（corporate treasury clients → business account holders；fraud-prevention protocol → payment verification rule）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 online treasury portal、domestic，但並未推出新系統；(D) 出現原文 settlement delays、November 22，日期與因果錯置；(B) 出現原文 authorized signatories、branch，僅須更新名單而非親臨辦匯款。

questions.q: According to the notice, what will cause a wire request to be rejected?
options: Failing to update the authorized signatory list before December 1
Initiating a domestic wire exceeding $50,000 without visiting a branch
Sending an international payment instruction via email instead of the portal
Requesting confirmation at a contact number not listed on the original agreement

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：銀行僅會撥打原始開戶協議中登記的主要電話號碼，要求改撥「電郵指示中提供的替代號碼」將自動拒絕，(D)「要求以未列於原始協議中的聯絡電話進行確認」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 email、portal，線上與電郵指示皆被允許；(A) 出現原文 authorized signatory list、December 1，未更新只會造成延誤而非因替代號碼被拒；(B) 出現原文 $50,000、branch，超過五萬須電話回撥而非親赴分行。

questions.q: Why is Priya at the Chicago warehouse?
options: To help the logistics manager transfer three forklifts to Milwaukee
To deliver signed dispatch sheets to the Chicago main office
To perform an on-site check of leased machinery for an audit
To inspect newly installed pallet racks before noon

explain.text:
• 考點：推論目的題（同義替換）。
• 解析：Daniel 說存貨稽核團隊需要租賃堆高機的序號，Priya 正在現場核對棧板貨架，(C)「為稽核執行租賃機具的實地核查」為同義改寫（inventory audit → audit；leased forklifts → leased machinery）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 logistics manager、three forklifts、Milwaukee，但移轉上週已發生；(B) 出現原文 signed dispatch sheets、main office，文件是向物流經理索取而非送去；(D) 出現原文 pallet racks、before noon，非主要目的。

questions.q: At 9:19 A.M., what does Daniel instruct Priya to do?
options: Remove the missing forklifts from the client's balance sheet
Upload the remaining pallet rack serial numbers before noon
Contact the Milwaukee depot to update its fixed-asset ledger
Take pictures of the signed documentation tracking moved machinery

explain.text:
• 考點：指令細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：9:19 A.M. Daniel 指示 Priya「索取跨倉移轉紀錄並拍攝已簽署的派車單」（photograph the signed dispatch sheets），(D)「拍攝追蹤已移動機具的已簽署文件照片」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 Milwaukee depot、fixed-asset ledger，但未要求聯繫該倉；(A) 出現原文 balance sheet，僅需核實而非逕行除帳；(B) 出現原文 remaining pallet rack、before noon，動作錯置。

questions.q: Why has the seller restricted access to Folder 4 in the VDR?
options: The acquiring firm operates in the same market as the acquisition candidate.
Only Apex Industrials' corporate development staff requested clean-room access.
The top-20 contracts contain unusual rebate clauses still under legal review.
The seller's investment bank has not finished redacting Folder 2 yet.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：因為買方客戶 Apex Industrials 是目標公司在工業閥門領域的「直接競爭對手」（direct competitor of the target），賣方才對 Folder 4 設下淨室限制，(A)「收購方與併購標的在同一市場競爭」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 investment bank、Folder 2，原因無中生有；(B) 出現原文 corporate development staff、clean-room，該團隊是被限制而非申請存取；(C) 出現原文 top-20 contracts、rebate clauses，非限制原因。

questions.q: Who is permitted to review the individual customer contracts in Folder 4?
options: Any team member who signs the encrypted Diligence Tracker by August 25
All buy-side diligence team members starting at 8:00 A.M. tomorrow
Arthur Pendelton and Apex Industrials' internal corporate development team
Outside attorneys along with a pair of assigned financial specialists

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：僅外部法律顧問與估值小組兩名指定分析師（Elena 和 Marcus）獲准檢視 Folder 4，(D)「外部律師以及兩名指派的財務專家」為同義改寫（external legal counsel → outside attorneys；two designated financial analysts → a pair of assigned financial specialists）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 Arthur Pendelton、corporate development，該部門明確被排除；(B) 出現原文 buy-side diligence team、8:00 A.M. tomorrow，並非全體成員；(A) 出現原文 encrypted Diligence Tracker、August 25，邏輯倒置。

questions.q: What are team members instructed NOT to do?
options: Grant Elena and Marcus access to Folder 4 before tomorrow morning
Report customer concentration risks in the encrypted Diligence Tracker
View aggregated revenue summaries in Folder 2 after 5:00 P.M.
Save local copies or produce hard copies of unedited documents

explain.text:
• 考點：否定細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：電郵提醒「禁止從虛擬資料室下載或列印未遮蔽的 PDF」（downloading or printing unredacted PDFs from the VDR is disabled），(D)「儲存本地複本或列印未經編輯的文件」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 Folder 2、5:00 P.M.，未禁止存取 Folder 2；(B) 出現原文 customer concentration risks、encrypted Diligence Tracker，若有發現必須登錄而非禁止；(A) 出現原文 Elena and Marcus、Folder 4，兩人本就獲准存取。

questions.q: What is the commitment fee if Solis Renewable Energy Corp. has a Total Debt to EBITDA ratio of 2.65x?

explain.text:
• 考點：表格查詢題。
• 解析：Total Debt / EBITDA 為 2.65x 落在 Tier 2（2.00x – 2.99x），對應的承諾費（Commitment Fee）為 (B) 0.35%。
• 誘答分析：(A) Tier 1 費率；(C) Tier 3 費率；(D) Tier 2 的利差加碼（Applicable Margin）而非承諾費。

questions.q: Which condition would constitute a breach of the financial conditions?
options: Submitting a prepayment of $1,000,000 with three business days' notice
Achieving a 2.85x ratio of EBITDA to Cash Interest Expense
Reporting a quarter-end leverage multiple above the 3.75x ceiling
Paying a 0.35% commitment fee on the undrawn facility balance

explain.text:
• 考點：條件判斷題（同義替換）。
• 解析：財務條款規定任何季末總負債對 EBITDA 比率「不得超過 3.75x」（shall not exceed 3.75x），(C)「季末申報超過 3.75 倍上限的槓桿倍數」即構成違約。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 0.35%、undrawn facility balance，這是正常費用；(B) 出現原文 2.85x、EBITDA to Cash Interest Expense，高於最低要求 2.50x 屬合規；(A) 出現原文 $1,000,000、three business days' notice，符合提前還款規定。

questions.q: What is required if the borrower wishes to pay back principal early without penalty?
options: Maintaining a Tier 1 leverage ratio at quarter-end
Keeping the facility's undrawn balance below $35,000,000
Paying in increments of at least $2,500,000 over SOFR
Giving the Administrative Agent advance notification in writing three working days prior

explain.text:
• 考點：條款細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：提前還款條款要求「提前 3 個營業日書面通知行政代理銀行」（3 business days' prior written notice is given to the Administrative Agent），(D)「提前三個工作日以書面通知行政代理機構」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 undrawn balance、$35,000,000，非提前還款條件；(C) 出現原文 SOFR，最低還款單位為 100 萬美元而非 250 萬；(A) 出現原文 Tier 1、quarter-end，無此要求。

questions.q: What mainly contributed to the fund's Q3 outperformance?
options: Avoiding Latin American currency markets during heightened volatility
Matching the +1.8% return of the benchmark index
Reallocating 12 percentage points into U.S. Treasury bills
Taking bearish positions on European sovereign debt and selective FX trades

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：第三季表現優於大盤主因是「策略性放空長天期歐洲公債及精選拉丁美洲貨幣交易」（tactical short positions in long-duration European government debt and selective currency trades），(D)「放空歐洲主權債並進行精選外匯交易」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 12 percentage points、U.S. Treasury bills，這是進入第四季的防禦性配置；(A) 出現原文 Latin American currency，敘述相反；(B) 出現原文 +1.8%、benchmark index，基金報酬為 +4.2% 而非僅符合基準。

questions.q: Why has the fund decreased its corporate credit exposure?
options: Floating-rate debt yields dropped below 4.7% over the past 18 months.
Speculative-grade issuers confront a challenging wave of upcoming debt rollovers.
European government debt outperformed corporate credit spreads in Q3.
Senior portfolio managers plan to announce a new strategy on November 14.

explain.text:
• 考點：因果細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：未來 18 個月到期的浮動利率高收益債發行人面臨嚴峻的「再融資高牆」（steep refinancing wall），(B)「非投資等級發行人面臨艱鉅的債務展期潮」為同義改寫（high-yield issuers → speculative-grade issuers；refinancing wall → wave of upcoming debt rollovers）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 European government debt、Q3，兩者無因果關係；(D) 出現原文 November 14、senior portfolio managers，那是年會日期；(A) 出現原文 4.7%、18 months，4.7% 是美國國庫券殖利率。

questions.q: The word "compress" in paragraph 2, line 3, is closest in meaning to:
options: stabilize
shrink
expand
fluctuate

explain.text:
• 考點：字義題。
• 解析：隨著基準利率居高不下，利息保障倍數持續「壓縮／縮減」（compress），最接近 (B) shrink（縮小、縮減）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 穩定、(C) 擴大、(D) 波動，皆不符上下文語意。

questions.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"This defensive cash buffer gives us ample dry powder to deploy if credit markets experience a sharp repricing."

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題。
• 解析：插入句開頭的 "This defensive cash buffer"（這筆防禦性現金緩衝）指的是「將資金轉入殖利率逾 4.7% 的短期美國國庫券」，而這件事在 [3] 後面那句（Consequently, we have reduced...）才提到，所以插入句要放在它之後的 [4]。放在 [3] 時國庫券還沒出現，This 沒有東西可以指。

questions.q: Who is the target market for LedgerFlow AI?
options: Local controllers who prefer manual spreadsheet matching
Global organizations overseeing numerous overseas business units
External audit firms seeking to reduce preparation time by 45%
Small domestic companies looking for free onboarding after December 15

explain.text:
• 考點：對象推論題（同義替換）。
• 解析：簡介主打為「擁有數十家國際子公司的跨國企業」（multi-entity enterprises / dozens of international subsidiaries）自動化對帳，(B)「管理眾多海外業務單位的跨國企業」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 external audit、45%，但產品是賣給企業內部財會而非外部會計師事務所；(D) 出現原文 December 15、complimentary onboarding，非目標客群描述；(A) 出現原文 local controllers、manual spreadsheet matching，目標客群正是想「淘汰」手工表單者。

questions.q: What happens when two subsidiaries record conflicting invoice amounts?
options: A structured resolution request with backup files is sent to both regional finance leads.
An adjustment journal is automatically posted without approval timestamps.
The system flags an FX translation variance above the materiality threshold.
Complimentary onboarding is required for up to 10 subsidiary entities.

explain.text:
• 考點：功能細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：當兩家子公司發票金額不符時，系統會將結構化爭議工單連同佐證 PDF 附件直接派送給雙方當地財務長（routes a structured ticket directly to both local controllers with supporting PDF attachments），(A)「附有佐證檔案的結構化處理請求會發送給雙方區域財務主管」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 FX translation variance、materiality threshold，那是多幣別自動核對功能；(B) 出現原文 adjustment journal、approval timestamps，不會未經核准自動過帳；(D) 出現原文 complimentary onboarding、10 subsidiary entities，概念無關。

questions.q: What is NOT mentioned as a feature of LedgerFlow AI?
options: Permanent recording of approval timestamps and matched entries
Real-time transaction matching across over 140 currencies
Automated tax-return preparation for overseas staff
Direct connectivity with SAP, Oracle NetSuite, and Microsoft Dynamics

explain.text:
• 考點：NOT 細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：手冊涵蓋 ERP 整合（SAP/Oracle/Microsoft）、超過 140 種幣別及稽核日誌記錄，唯獨未提及 (C) 海外員工自動化薪資報稅申報。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B)(A) 皆為原文 Capabilities 中明確列舉之功能。

questions.q: What would the proposed regulation require mid-sized banks to do?
options: Stop lending to corporate clients with unrealized bond losses
Limit total assets to between $100 billion and $250 billion
Incorporate paper losses on certain securities into their solvency metrics
Adopt the exact same capital buffers as G-SIBs within 60 days

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：監管提案要求資產 1,000 億至 2,500 億美元的區域銀行在計算監管資本適足率時，「計入備供出售（AFS）證券的未實現損失」，(C)「將特定證券的帳面虧損納入其償付能力指標計算」為同義改寫（unrealized losses → paper losses；capital ratios → solvency metrics）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 $100 billion、$250 billion，那是適用銀行的資產門檻而非限制；(D) 出現原文 G-SIBs、60 days，60 天是公眾意見徵詢期；(A) 出現原文 corporate clients、unrealized bond losses，曲解要求。

questions.q: How long would affected banks have to fully comply with the new capital requirement?
options: Five years
One year
Three years
60 days

explain.text:
• 考點：時間細節題。
• 解析：第二段指出中型銀行將有三年的過渡期（three-year phase-in period）來建立額外資本緩衝，對應 (C) Three years。
• 誘答分析：(D) 60 天為公眾意見徵詢期；(B)(A) 皆未提及。

questions.q: What concern did banking industry groups raise about the proposal?
options: It might tighten financing access for smaller enterprises and raise loan costs.
Unrealized bond losses could force global systemically important banks to fail.
Regional banks would have to wait three years before building additional capital buffers.
Consumer advocates and independent analysts were excluded from the 60-day comment period.

explain.text:
• 考點：觀點細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：銀行業團體警告該規範可能迫使區域銀行縮減中小企業放款並將較高借貸成本轉嫁給企業客戶（curtail small-business lending and pass higher borrowing costs onto corporate clients），(A)「可能緊縮小型企業的融資管道並提高貸款成本」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 consumer advocates、independent analysts、60-day，未提被排除；(B) 出現原文 unrealized bond losses、G-SIBs，與業者的擔憂無關；(C) 出現原文 three years、additional capital buffers，這是給銀行的過渡期而非擔憂點。

questions.q: What is Veridian Holdings doing with its Nordic Packaging Division?
options: Transferring all global finance staff to the Nordic division
Divesting the business unit to an external industrial buyer
Acquiring a €280 million packaging subsidiary in September
Integrating its IT, HR, and treasury functions into Skandia Industrial Partners

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：備忘錄宣布 Veridian Holdings 已簽署具約束力協議，以 2.8 億歐元將北歐包裝部門「剝離出售給 Skandia Industrial Partners」（divest... to），(B)「將該業務單位出售給外部工業買家」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 IT, HR, and treasury functions、Skandia Industrial Partners，實際上是要將共用功能從母公司「分離」；(C) 出現原文 €280 million、September，是「出售」而非「收購」；(A) 出現原文 global finance staff，未提調職。

questions.q: What is Maya Patel's primary responsibility?
options: Posting new allocation codes on the Finance Intranet for Henrik Lindqvist
Closing the €280 million carve-out transaction before May 6
Managing Veridian's core corporate infrastructure after September
Overseeing the creation of multi-year independent financial reports for the spun-off unit

explain.text:
• 考點：職責細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：Maya Patel 擔任過渡期分拆財務長，負責帶領小組編製「過去三個會計年度的獨立經稽核分拆財報」，(D)「主導為該分拆單位編製多年期獨立財務報告」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 allocation codes、Finance Intranet，代碼已經公告；(B) 出現原文 €280 million、May 6，交割日為九月；(C) 出現原文 core corporate infrastructure、September，對象錯置。

questions.q: What are accounting staff supporting Nordic Packaging instructed to do?
options: Send historical intercompany balance questions to Henrik Lindqvist
Use revised coding to isolate joint corporate expenses
Draft audited stand-alone financial statements for the past three years
Wait until September to separate shared IT and HR overhead

explain.text:
• 考點：指令細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：所有支援該部門的會計人員必須「使用財務內網上公告的新分攤代碼來區隔共用企業管理費用」（segregate shared corporate overhead expenses using the new allocation codes），(B)「採用修訂後的代碼以區分共同企業費用」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 historical intercompany balances、Henrik Lindqvist，有問題應找「Maya 的團隊」而非財務長；(D) 出現原文 September、IT and HR，不能等到九月；(C) 出現原文 audited stand-alone financial statements，那是 Maya 帶領專案小組的工作。

questions.q: How much would a Premier Treasury Account holder pay for sending 14 domestic outgoing wires in one month?

explain.text:
• 考點：表格計算題。
• 解析：Premier Treasury Account 國內匯出電匯前 10 筆免費（first 10 free/month），之後每筆 $12。寄送 14 筆須付費 14 − 10 = 4 筆，費用為 4 × $12 = $48 (A)。
• 誘答分析：(B) 誤算 10 × $12；(C) 誤算 14 × $12（忘記扣除前 10 筆免費）；(D) 誤用 Standard Account 費率 14 × $25。

questions.q: Which feature is included at no extra charge for Premier Treasury Account clients?
options: Automated check-fraud screening protection
Unlimited international SWIFT wires
Zero-spread foreign exchange conversion
Waived ACH batch origination fees

explain.text:
• 考點：表格細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：表格最後一列顯示 Premier Treasury Account 的「Positive Pay 詐欺過濾器」（支票防偽過濾服務）為 Included（免費內含），(A)「自動化支票防詐欺篩選保護」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B)(D)(C) 在表格中皆標示單筆收費或另行報價，並非免費內含。

questions.q: Under what condition is the $45 monthly fee waived for a Standard Account?
options: Fewer than 10 domestic outgoing wires are sent each month.
The account holds at least $50,000 on average across the cycle.
The client keeps an average collected balance of $250,000.
The account avoids two consecutive billing cycles of SWIFT transfers.

explain.text:
• 考點：表格條件題（同義替換）。
• 解析：Standard Account 的 $45 月維護費在「平均餘額達 $50,000」（with $50k avg. balance）時免收，(B)「帳戶在計費週期內平均持有至少五萬美元」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) $250,000 為 Premier 帳戶門檻；(A) 10 筆免費是 Premier 電匯優惠；(D) two consecutive billing cycles 是「未達標」時收費的判定條件。

questions.q: When will the auditors observe physical inventory counts?
options: October 23
November 18
January 18
February 24

explain.text:
• 考點：時間細節題。
• 解析：Phase 2 明確記載稽核員將於 11 月 18 日（November 18）在丹佛與鳳凰城配送中心實地盤點存貨，對應 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(A) Phase 1 結束日；(C) Phase 3 開始日；(D) 向審計委員會簡報日。

questions.q: Which task is scheduled during Phase 3?
options: Finalizing the draft Form 10-K presentation for February 24
Updating materiality thresholds and prior-year management letter points
Obtaining third-party verification from clients and financial institutions
Conducting walkthroughs of the order-to-cash cycle in Denver

explain.text:
• 考點：階段細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：Phase 3（期末實質性外勤）包含「向主要客戶與往來銀行寄發獨立函證」（send independent confirmations to major customers and depository banks），(C)「透過直接函證核實客戶與銀行餘額」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B) 為 Phase 1 任務；(D) 為 Phase 2 任務；(A) 為 Phase 4 任務。

questions.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Any control deficiencies identified during these walkthroughs must be communicated to management before year-end testing begins."

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題。
• 解析：插入句中的 "these walkthroughs"（這些穿行測試）直接回指 Phase 2 第一句的 "Perform walkthroughs of the order-to-cash and procure-to-pay cycles"，故置於 [2]。

questions.q: Why did Titan Logistics Corp. reduce its acquisition offer?
options: Investigators uncovered steeper vehicle upkeep outlays and an underfunded retirement obligation.
Core cold-chain trucking revenue grew slower than 9% in Q2.
Stock consideration in Titan Shares was eliminated from the July 9 model.
The Board of Directors rejected the June 15 enterprise value of $210 million.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：盡職調查團隊發現高於預期的「車隊維修費用」以及 650 萬美元「未提撥退休金負債」，導致買方下修報價，(A)「調查人員發現較高的車輛保養支出與提撥不足的退休義務」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 9%、Q2，原文是「成長」9% 而非低於 9%；(D) 出現原文 June 15、$210 million，並非董事會否決；(C) 出現原文 Titan Shares、July 9，股票對價是從 5,000 萬調降為 3,500 萬而非取消。

questions.q: By how much was the upfront cash consideration reduced in the revised offer?
options: $6.5 million
$15.0 million
$30.0 million
$35.0 million

explain.text:
• 考點：表格計算題。
• 解析：頭期現金對價（Upfront Cash Consideration）從初始報價 $160.0M 降至修訂報價 $145.0M，減少了 $15.0 million (B)。
• 誘答分析：(A) $6.5M 為退休金負債；(C) $30.0M 為現金＋股票合計降幅；(D) $35.0M 為修訂後股票對價。

questions.q: How is the $15.0 million earn-out structured?

It covers Harbor Freight's $6.5 million unfunded pension liability.
It will be paid out during Friday's Special Board Vote.

questions.q: What can be inferred about the estimated annual cost synergies?

They are tied to FY2027 EBITDA targets as a contingent earn-out.
They offset the $15.0 million reduction in upfront cash consideration.
Their expected yearly savings were trimmed by $800,000 in the updated model.

• 解析：預估年度成本綜效（Estimated Annual Cost Synergies）從 $8.2M 下調至 $7.4M，(D)「更新模型中的預期年度節省金額下修了 80 萬美元」為精準推論。

questions.q: Which finding in the audit report was rated as the highest risk?
options: Electronic transfers issued without mandatory secondary sign-off
Seven vendors whose payments were temporarily suspended on October 8
New suppliers added to the master file without verified W-9 tax forms
Invoice #88412 paid twice to Apex Courier Services

explain.text:
• 考點：跨表細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：稽核報告中 Risk Level 唯一標示為 High 的是 AP-01：「三筆總計 $184,000 的電匯未經資金部二次核准即放行」，(A)「未經強制二次簽核即發出的電子轉帳」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 為 Medium 風險；(D) 為 Low 風險；(B) 出現原文 October 8、temporarily suspended，並非最高風險項目。

questions.q: What action did Patricia's team take to fix Finding AP-01?
options: Set up automated workflow controls blocking single-approver payouts above $25,000
Temporarily suspended all wire payments totaling $184,000
Enabled a duplicate-check flag in the ERP system yesterday
Required secondary treasury approval for invoice #88412

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：針對 AP-01，IT 管理員昨天更新了 ERP 流程，凡超過 $25,000 的撥款若無兩名不同核決者電子簽核將自動阻擋，(A)「設定自動化流程控管以阻擋超過 2.5 萬美元的單人核准付款」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 $184,000，並非全面暫停；(C) 出現原文 duplicate-check flag，那是 AP-03 的建議；(D) 出現原文 #88412，項目錯置。

questions.q: What is the status of Finding AP-02 as of October 8?
options: All seven vendors have already uploaded their verified tax IDs.
A pair of suppliers have yet to turn in their required tax paperwork.
Five vendors had their payments permanently blocked in the master file.
Two vendors have until October 5 to submit their W-9 forms.

explain.text:

• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 verified tax IDs，尚有兩家未交；(C) 出現原文 five vendors，五家已交而非被永久封鎖；(D) 出現原文 October 5，日期為報告發布日而非補件期限。

questions.q: How was the overpayment to Apex Courier Services resolved?
options: Patricia's team blocked future payments to Apex Courier Services.
The $12,400 duplicate invoice was credited to the Q3 exception report.
Apex Courier Services refunded $12,400 via wire payment.
The vendor offset the excess charge on the subsequent month's bill.

questions.q: What does Patricia ask Gregory to do?

Arrange a time to conduct verification checks on the remediated items
Update the ERP workflow for disbursements below $25,000

questions.q: What is Greenway Precision Plastics using the $8,000,000 loan for?
options: Acquiring automated production machinery for its Texas site
Increasing its FY2026 Gross Profit Margin to 31.0%
Securing a 3-year supply contract extension in Austin
Refinancing an existing 7-year equipment term loan
