questions.q: Based on the financial ratio table, which statement is TRUE?
options: Gross Profit Margin fell from 29.1% in FY2024 to 28.4% in FY2025.
Fixed Charge Coverage rose steadily from 1.65x in FY2024 to 1.42x in FY2026.
Short-term liquidity ratios stay above the lender's 1.30x floor across all listed periods.
Projected FY2026 Debt-to-EBITDA (2.85x) violates the 3.25x policy cap.

explain.text:
• 考點：表格綜合判斷題（同義替換）。
• 解析：Greenway 的流動比率（Current Ratio）在 FY2024–FY2026 分別為 1.55x、1.60x、1.48x，皆高於銀行最低政策門檻 1.30x，(C)「短期流動性比率在所有列出期間皆高於放款方 1.30 倍的下限」為正確敘述。
• 誘答分析：(D) 2.85x 低於 3.25x 上限，並未違規；(B) 1.65x → 1.80x → 1.42x，並非逐年上升；(A) 毛利率從 28.4% 升至 29.1%，並非下降。

questions.q: What risk factor prompted the Credit Committee to attach conditions to the approval?
options: The bank lacks a primary claim on the new equipment.
Projected FY2026 Debt-to-EBITDA rises to 2.85x.
The Austin machinery was appraised at $9.6M rather than $8.0M.
Almost 40% of total sales depend on one major buyer.

explain.text:
• 考點：多文件整合題（同義替換）。
• 解析：授信委員會電郵指出「借款人的最大客戶佔總營收的 38%」（top customer accounts for 38% of total revenue），因此附加兩項交割前條件，(D)「總營收有將近四成依賴單一主要買家」為同義改寫（38% → almost 40%）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 $9.6M、$8.0M，擔保品價值其實高於貸款額；(B) 出現原文 FY2026 Debt-to-EBITDA、2.85x，該比率符合政策；(A) 出現原文 primary claim，銀行確實擁有第一順位求償權。

questions.q: What must Greenway provide before the loan can close?
options: Proof that its top customer accounts for less than 38% of revenue
Revised FY2026 pro-forma ratios approved by Credit Risk
An active insurance certificate protecting the lender and a renewed key-buyer agreement
A signed 7-year repayment guarantee from Kevin Park

explain.text:
• 考點：條件細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：撥款前須滿足兩項先決條件：1. 最大客戶簽署的三年期供應合約展延；2. 載明 Crestview Bank 為賠款受領人的財產意外險保單（binding property-casualty insurance binder），(C)「保護放款方的有效保險證明以及續簽的主要買家協議」為同義改寫。

questions.q: What is Kevin Park instructed to do next?
options: Deliver the formal loan offer once the borrower accepts the terms
Release the $8.0M term loan funds to the Austin plant immediately
Obtain the binding property-casualty insurance binder before November 2
Ask the Credit Committee to waive the two conditions precedent

explain.text:

• 解析：電郵最後指示 Kevin「一旦確認客戶接受這些條件，請核發承諾函」（issue the commitment letter to the client once you confirm they accept these conditions），(A)「在借款人接受條款後發出正式貸款要約」為同義改寫。

Funding Oakridge Asset Management's Core ESG Bond Fund

questions.q: What condition did Marcus Holloway attach to Oakridge Asset Management's order?

The bonds had to price at the bottom of the 4.60% – 4.85% indicative range.
The investment required a minimum interest rate of 4.75% to proceed.
Both S&P and Moody's had to affirm the AA- / Aa3 ratings prior to allocation.

questions.q: Why did the bond issue price at 4.65%?

Sterling Morgan Securities limited allocations to 0% for ESG funds.
The indicative coupon range was narrowed to 4.65% at 10:15 A.M.
Oakridge Asset Management dropped its $25,000,000 order from the book.

• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 Oakridge Asset Management、$25,000,000，撤單是因為利率低於 4.75%，而非導致降息的原因；(C) 出現原文 4.65%、10:15 A.M.，10:15 是下單時間；(B) 出現原文 0%、ESG funds，僅 Oakridge 獲配 0%。

questions.q: How much of the bond offering did Oakridge Asset Management receive?

questions.q: What option does the Bond Sales Desk suggest if Oakridge still wants to own the bonds?

Increasing its yield floor to 4.75% in the 4:30 P.M. email
Waiting until November 15 to buy directly from Pacific Grid & Water Authority
Requesting a partial allocation from the 3.4x oversubscribed book

questions.q: What will happen to Novagen Diagnostics' San Diego R&D campus?

It will be consolidated into Vertex's Boston headquarters over six months.
It will remain open and maintain normal research operations.
Dr. Alan Reyes will oversee its closure on June 3.

questions.q: What must Novagen employees do when submitting travel expenses on June 5?

Wait for Session B of the June 3 Town Hall before submitting receipts
File claims via the designated expense system using a temporary code
Route all travel reports through Vertex's Workday payroll platform

questions.q: Which statement is NOT supported by the documents?
options: Finance, accounting, and tax staff are scheduled for a 1:30 P.M. EST meeting on June 3.

Legal compliance and corporate finance functions will move to Boston.
Vertex BioLabs now fully owns Novagen Diagnostics following a $1.2 billion deal.
